text: A complete Segal space (Rezk 2001) is a simplicial space W such that:
choices: the Segal maps are equivalences (Segal condition) AND the map from equivalences to identities is a weak equivalence (completeness)
W is a nerve of a 1-category
explanation: Complete Segal spaces (Rezk): the Segal condition makes W a Segal space (homotopy-coherent category); completeness adds the Rezk condition (iso=identity). They model (∞,1)-categories.
